resources.string: You can unplug now to spare the battery.
The battery is full. You can unplug now to spare it.
The battery has been warm for a couple of minutes. Heat wears it out and slows charging. Take off the case or charge somewhere cooler.
Tells you once per charge when the battery reaches this level, so you can unplug early. Batteries age slower when they are not kept full.
Tells you once per charge when the battery is full.
Tells you when the battery stays at 40 °C or more for two minutes while plugged in, at most once an hour.
These alarms follow the Alerts switch.
Measures for 30 seconds what this charger and cable deliver into the battery. Keep this screen open.
The test stopped because the phone stopped charging.
This phone does not report the charging current, so there is nothing to measure.
Results depend on the battery level and temperature: a full or warm battery takes less power. Compare tests at a similar level.
Estimated from every charge that added at least 30 %. Rough for a single charge, but the trend counts.
